text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing with Loves Only You,
I asked her why she seemed in such high spirits.
choice_data_list: If you'd like, do you want to stay out a little longer?
If you'd like, shall we stay out a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I follow up by asking a surprised Loves Only You, "What do you think?", I recall what happened yesterday—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Am I tired lately?" ...Hmm, maybe so.
I guess I haven't had much time to truly relax.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I really want to take a proper break.
choice_data_list: (I need to make sure she gets a proper break today!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha♡ To think Trainer-kun would suggest it
before I even had the chance to ask!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha♡ To think Trainer-chan would suggest it
before I even had the chance to ask!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! There are still so many
places I want to go together! Will you come with me?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll go with you anywhere!
Yeah, I'll go anywhere with you!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Phew♪ ...I think that's just about everything we needed, right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I was so lucky the blender I wanted
was on sale ♡ Oh, and the mouse too!
choice_data_list: ...That turned into quite a lot, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! You thought I was wasting money, didn't you?
I am *not* wasting it!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"If I want to properly connect with everyone,
I can't compromise on my equipment! ♡"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
………………
…………All right.
choice_data_list: Ngyah!? Waaaah-wah-wah— (echo)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. That makes 5 wins in a row!
Want to keep going, Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. That makes 5 wins in a row!
Want to keep going, Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I don't go easy on anyone in fighting games,
no matter how many rounds we play, you know? You ready?
choice_data_list: I'm having fun taking on the challenge, so it's fine!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Alright, one more time!
I'll beat you fair and square as many times as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmm♡♡♡
So lovelyyy~~!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer-kun, you try it too! Quick!
I bet you'll make the exact same face!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer-chan, you too! Hurry up and try some!
I bet you'll make the exact same face!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At her urging, I take a bite of the raspberry pancake
—an elegant sweet and tart flavor immediately fills my mouth.
choice_data_list: ...You're right. It's so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu♡
What a wonderful expression.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad. Being able to share what I love with you, that is.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad. Being able to share what I love with you, that is.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We did our shopping, and we got to hang out together...
Today really was the best day ever!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer-kun.
choice_data_list: Same here. It was a nice breather.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer-chan.
choice_data_list: Same here. It was a nice breather.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Really? Well, that's great to hear!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I gave Miss Bridge
that "I wanna hang out~" signal yesterday ♡
choice_data_list: ...Hm? What did you say?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you didn't notice?
The truth is—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Has Bridge-san not logged in yet?
...Well then, that works out just fine.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hey, everyone, listen to this~.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-kun's been so busy lately that he
hasn't paid any attention to me~. What should I do?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-chan's been so busy lately that she
hasn't paid any attention to me~. What should I do?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh? "Let's put on an act!"... you say?
What do you mean specifically?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm... "Once the Bridge makes his entrance,
act like you're feeling weak"——

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Love that idea!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm so glad I asked everyone for their thoughts♡
With this—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. But wait. If Trainer-kun scrolls back through the comments, won't I get caught?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. But wait. If Trainer-chan scrolls back through the comments, won't I get caught?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I'll delete the comments!" "Leaving no archives behind!"
...Aww, are you guys geniuses or what?! Thanks a bunch~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And so...
I'm so sorry, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: And with that... I'm so sorry, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you mad? ...I'm really sorry, okay?
But—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to play... together with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't feel even a shred of anger.
I felt that from now on, I should let her pamper herself
before it ever came to this.
choice_data_list: If you'd just told me, I would've gone with you anytime.
You even got one over on everyone in the community, huh.
You even got one over on everyone in the community!

text_block_list.text:

There was no need to hold back after all.

text_block_list.text:
“—Well, you already gave your word.
Looking forward to working with you, Trainer-kun~”

However—

text_block_list.text: The moment you jumped in, everyone went dead silent—I almost burst out laughing!

...So that's what that silence was about!

Fufu.
They truly are irreplaceable, aren't they?
